title: The Brush sits right after Crop on a picture's tool bar, where the mock draws it
goal: On a picture the Brush button sits near the right end of the tool bar beside the paint bucket, while the image mock (and Photoshop) put it with the first tools, right after Crop. Move it to the mock's place so a Photoshop user finds it where they look.
notes: Found by the brush epic final audit (a-brush-tool-paints-with-realistic-charcoal-chal), 2026-10-31. Mock order: Select, Lasso, Magic wand, Crop, Brush (B), Eraser, Heal, Clone stamp, Patch, Dodge/Burn, Pen, Text, Shape, Measure, Hand, Zoom. Shipped (Next defaults, 1280 pt window, 2026-10-31-brush-epic-1-watercolour-in-hand-sc.png): Select, Marquee, Crop, Measure | Arrow, Line, Highlighter, Text, Combine, Rectangle, Pen, Component | Brush | Bucket | Hand | Color. The bar adds flag tools at the end of the drawing family (slice 1 note on the umbrella, 2026-10-25). Brush is absent on a document with time (B is the Blade there), so only the picture bar changes. grep Scripts/playtest for tool bar points before moving it.
acceptance: On a picture at Next defaults, the tool bar reads Select, Marquee, Crop, then Brush, matching the order the image mock draws (docs/design/mocks/pages/image.html, tool bar)
Every walk that clicks a tool bar button by its position still lands on the tool it meant, updated in the same commit
A side by side of the shipped tool bar and the mock tool bar is in the audit
